clock.note: Stamped messages (/odom, /gz/dynamic_pose, joint states) carry the simulator's own time, so their uncertainty on that clock is zero. The action status topic has no stamp: it is placed on the simulation clock from the recorder's receipt time and the recorded /clock (ros2_evidence.py, time 'clock'). ASSUMPTION: the recorder receives a status message no more than 50 ms of simulation time after it was published.

source.dataset: openamr-upperbody-sw in Gazebo (gz sim, ROS 2 Jazzy), recorded by gazebo/run_experiment.sh
source.note: SIMULATION. The 'independent' evidence is the physics engine's own link pose, which is independent of the controllers' state and the odometry plugin, but not of the simulator.
